# `sam_opportunity_snapshots`

**SAM opportunities source snapshots**

Exact selected original, declared scope and observed population counts.

**Coverage.** Window. One declared agency and inclusive posted-date interval in an explicitly selected public notices file. All matching rows and revisions remain; no all-version history or attachment custody is inferred. Source deadlines retain their original precision and time zone spelling. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `sam_opportunity_snapshots.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_id` | `VARCHAR` | Digest of source kind, original capture, selected scope and explicit text encoding; not a native SAM identifier. |
| `source_kind` | `VARCHAR` | opportunities or exclusions; never entity registrations or spending awards. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Original public download request. Temporary signed redirect credentials are omitted. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained original ZIP or CSV bytes. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Capture time with explicit time zone; distinct from publisher dates. |
| `snapshot_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date stated by a dated exclusions filename. NULL for the rolling notice filename, which states no snapshot date. |
| `selection_json` | `VARCHAR` | Exact declared population or agency/date window. Notices use the source calendar date without inferred time zone conversion. |
| `coverage_limit` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit source/population limitation for this selected file. |
| `text_encoding` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit decoding used for native CSV cells. latin-1 preserves bytes reversibly; non-ASCII interpretation remains unqualified. No guessed text repair. |
| `source_rows` | `BIGINT` | Physical data records read through complete CSV EOF; excludes the header. |
| `selected_rows` | `BIGINT` | Records retained within the declared scope, including repeated native IDs. |
| `distinct_native_ids` | `BIGINT` | Distinct native ID values in the selected rows; not a count of real-world parties. |
| `unqualified_text_rows` | `BIGINT` | Selected observations with at least one unqualified non-ASCII field. Identify affected fields and records through the observation table. |
